months.4: Spring clears the forest and lake trails, while the strenuous high-elevation routes remain closed by snow and ice.
months.5: Most trails are clear and green, though the highest passes and peaks still hold snow and require winter gear.
months.10: Autumn colors fill the valleys and trails are excellent, though early snow can close the highest strenuous routes.

black-forest.overview: The Black Forest offers a vast network of trails through dense conifers, open pastures, and deep gorges, with cable cars lifting hikers to the higher ridges. The Westweg is a famous 177-mile trek running the length of the region in about two weeks. Day hikes range from easy lakeside paths to climbs up the Feldberg, the highest peak.

months.1: Groomed winter trails and snowshoe routes are open, making for easy walking in the snow, while the main high trails are closed.
months.2: Groomed winter trails and snowshoe routes are open, making for easy walking in the snow, while the main high trails are closed.
months.4: Lower valley paths and gorge trails open up for day hikes, though the highest peaks may still hold patches of snow.
months.6: The best walking of the year, with all trails and huts open for the Westweg trek and day hikes to the Feldberg summit.
months.7: The best walking of the year, with all trails and huts open for the Westweg trek and day hikes to the Feldberg summit.
months.8: The best walking of the year, with all trails and huts open for the Westweg trek and day hikes to the Feldberg summit.
months.10: Autumn colors arrive and the trails remain clear, though shorter daylight means starting early on longer routes.

bhutan.overview: Bhutan offers some of the most dramatic and remote hiking in the Himalayas, from steep forest day hikes to legendary high-altitude expedition treks. The steep climb to the cliffside Tiger's Nest monastery is the main day hike, while the multi-week Snowman Trek and the shorter Druk Path Trek cross remote passes beneath unclimbed peaks. All hiking requires a licensed guide and a daily fee, keeping the trails pristine. The best hiking is in spring and autumn.

months.1: High passes are blocked by deep snow, closing the multi-day treks, but the lower valleys offer clear, cold days for day hikes to monasteries.
months.2: Winter snow still blocks the high-altitude routes, but the lower trails begin to warm, making it a good time for easy valley walks.
months.3: Spring arrives and the trekking season opens. The Druk Path and other mid-elevation routes are clear, with rhododendrons blooming along the trails.
months.10: The absolute peak for walking. The skies are crystal clear, offering the best views of the high Himalayas, and every route from day hikes to expedition treks is in prime condition.

belfast-giants-causeway.overview: The coastal cliffs and heather-covered granite peaks offer strong regional hiking, anchored by the Causeway Coast Way, a 33-mile trek over two to three days past basalt columns and ruined castles. Day hikers head to the Mourne Mountains for strenuous, steep climbs up Slieve Donard, or the Glens of Antrim for forest and waterfall loops. The trails are best from May to September, though rain is possible year-round.

months.2: The mountains remain wet and boggy with frequent high winds, keeping the high ridges strenuous and exposed. Coastal walks offer dramatic scenery between winter storms.
months.4: Spring brings better conditions to the glens and coastal cliffs, with forest loops fully accessible. The mountain routes are clearer, though sudden rain showers are common.
months.10: Autumn winds pick up and the mountain trails become boggy again. The forest loops in the glens offer sheltered walking, while the exposed coastal trek requires sturdy rain gear.

beijing.overview: The hiking here is defined by the Great Wall, offering routes along ancient stone paths and crumbling watchtowers that trace the mountain ridges. Visitors typically take a shuttle or cable car to reach restored sections like Mutianyu and Jinshanling for day hikes, while wild stretches like Jiankou offer strenuous scrambling. The best hiking is in spring and autumn when the air is clear and temperatures are mild.

months.3: Temperatures begin to rise, thawing the trails and making the walks along the restored walls more comfortable, though the air on the ridges can still be brisk.
months.5: The mild, clear weather continues, providing ideal conditions for strenuous scrambles on the wild sections and walks on the restored walls.

barcelona.overview: The best hiking lies just outside the city, with the serrated peaks of Montserrat offering strenuous day hikes to the Sant Jeroni summit for views stretching to the Pyrenees. Closer in, the wooded ridges of the Collserola range provide trails above the city, easily reached by funicular or train. The Mediterranean climate makes hiking possible year-round, though summer afternoons are intensely hot.

amalfi.overview: The steep cliffs and terraced hillsides above the Mediterranean offer excellent day hikes, led by the famous Path of the Gods. This route follows the high ridges between Bomerano and Nocelle, delivering sweeping views of the coastline and the sea. Other trails explore deep gorges like the Valle delle Ferriere, passing waterfalls and ruins. Most trailheads are reached by local bus or by hiking up from the coastal towns.

bend-crater-lake.overview: The volcanic landscapes of Central Oregon offer routes ranging from loops along the deep blue waters of Crater Lake to strenuous ascents in the high Cascades. Walkers can explore easy paths along the Deschutes River near Bend or tackle the strenuous climb up South Sister for panoramic views of glaciers and cinder cones. Central Cascades wilderness permits are required for many of the best high-elevation mountain routes from mid-June to mid-October.

months.4: The high elevations remain under deep snow, keeping mountain routes closed. Lower-elevation paths along the Deschutes River near Bend are clear and offer easy walking.
months.7: The high passes and Crater Lake rim trails are fully clear, offering strenuous summit hikes and caldera views. The weather is warm and dry, and Central Cascades wilderness permits are required.
months.8: The high passes and Crater Lake rim trails are fully clear, offering strenuous summit hikes and caldera views. The weather is warm and dry, and Central Cascades wilderness permits are required. Wildfire smoke is most likely now, so check air quality before heading up.
months.9: The high passes and Crater Lake rim trails are clear, offering strenuous summit hikes and caldera views. The weather is warm and dry, and Central Cascades wilderness permits are required. Wildfire smoke can still haze the air early in the month.

bagan.overview: Hiking here focuses on village-to-village routes through agricultural landscapes and forested hills, best known for the two- to three-day trek from Kalaw to Inle Lake. Day hikes explore the hills around Hsipaw or the slopes of Mount Victoria. The routes pass through rural communities and tea plantations, earning views of the rolling countryside, with the best conditions during the cooler, dry months.

months.12: Clear skies and cool temperatures provide perfect conditions for the trek to Inle Lake.

belize.overview: Belize offers tropical forest trails leading to hidden waterfalls and sweeping jungle canopy views. The best day hikes are found in the Cockscomb Basin Wildlife Sanctuary and Mayflower Bocawina National Park, where paths climb steeply through dense foliage. The dry months provide the most reliable footing, as heavy rains quickly turn the clay trails slick.

months.1: The dry season settles in, leaving jungle trails mostly firm and accessible. Waterfall hikes in the Cockscomb Basin are at their best.
months.7: Frequent rain keeps the jungle paths waterlogged. The mud and high humidity make the loops slow and less enjoyable.
months.12: The trails dry out as the wet season ends. Footing improves significantly, and the jungle loops become pleasant again.

months.10: Fall foliage makes the coastal and mountain views spectacular. The park is heavily crowded with leaf-peepers, so use the shuttle, which runs until mid-October, to reach the ridge hikes.

arches-canyonlands.overview: The hiking here explores two distinct desert landscapes: the concentrated sandstone fins and windows of Arches, and the vast, deep gorges of Canyonlands. Most routes are day hikes across bare slickrock, leading to iconic formations like Delicate Arch or the canyon rims at Island in the Sky. The Needles district offers longer strenuous day hikes and multi-day routes through colorful sandstone spires. The labyrinth of the Fiery Furnace requires a specific permit to enter.

angkor.overview: Cambodia offers jungle treks and waterfall day hikes, mostly in the Cardamom Mountains, Virachey National Park, and the hills of Mondulkiri. Routes range from day hikes to multi-day jungle treks that require a local guide. The dry months from November to February offer the best conditions, while heavy rains later in the year turn trails into deep mud.

months.1: The dry, cooler weather makes this the best time for jungle treks and day hikes in the hills.
months.4: Heat makes long walks exhausting; early morning starts are essential for any day hike.
months.11: Dry weather returns, clearing the mud and reopening the multi-day treks and hill paths.

andalucia.overview: Hiking ranges from the high peaks of the Sierra Nevada to deep limestone gorges, with the Caminito del Rey as the best-known route. Pinned to the sheer walls of the Gaitanes Gorge, this walk requires a timed ticket, and most visitors take a shuttle to the start. The high mountains offer strenuous day hikes to summits like Mulhacén. The hiking is best in spring and autumn, as summer heat is extreme.

months.1: The lower trails and coastal ranges are cool and clear, making for excellent walking. The high Sierra Nevada is under snow, closing the high peaks to ordinary hikers.
months.11: The lower trails are cool and quiet, offering excellent walking. Snow begins to fall in the high Sierra Nevada, closing the highest routes.

algarve.overview: The Algarve is known for its dramatic coastal hiking, led by the Seven Hanging Valleys trail that traces limestone cliffs and sea caves above the Atlantic. For multi-day routes, the Fishermen's Trail is an 11- to 13-day, 135-mile coastal trek along the rugged west, while the 186-mile Via Algarviana crosses the inland hills in 14 stages. Shade is scarce, so spring and autumn are best and summer needs a dawn start.

months.4: One of the best months to walk the coast. The weather is warm but not hot, perfect for the cliff paths and long days on the Via Algarviana.

budapest.overview: The Buda Hills rise directly above the city, offering a network of forest trails. Hikers can reach the trailheads by bus or the historic cogwheel railway to walk the popular ridge paths around Normafa and János-hegy. The highest point provides panoramic views over the city.

months.3: Spring arrives with clearing paths and budding forests, making the climbs to János-hegy much more pleasant.
months.8: Warm and humid conditions continue; the tree cover offers relief on the ascents above the city.

bali.overview: Bali's hiking centers on its volcanic peaks and lush interior. The best-known route is the Mount Batur sunrise hike, which requires a local guide arranged at the trailhead to navigate the dark, rocky path to the crater rim. Easier walking weaves through the island's famous rice terraces and jungle waterfalls. The trails are best from April to October when the ground is dry and the summit views are clear.

months.9: The trails remain dry and the mornings clear, keeping the strenuous volcano climbs and jungle walks in great condition.

azores.overview: Volcanic craters, coastal cliffs and lush laurel forests define the hiking on these mid-Atlantic islands. The best-known route is the strenuous climb up Mount Pico, Portugal's highest peak, which rewards hikers with panoramic ocean views. Other highlights include the trails around Faial's Caldeira crater and the paths circling the twin lakes of Sete Cidades. The trails are walkable year-round, though rain frequently obscures the heights.

months.1: Frequent rain and low clouds often obscure the volcanic rims and make the steep trails muddy. The sheltered coastal paths and lower forest routes remain fully walkable.
months.2: Frequent rain and low clouds often obscure the volcanic rims and make the steep trails muddy. The sheltered coastal paths and lower forest routes remain fully walkable.
months.3: Rain is common, but clear days open up the views from the lower crater rims. The coastal paths are lush and green, offering walking along the cliffs.
months.4: Drier conditions improve traction on the steep volcanic slopes. The coastal paths are lush and offer walking without the deep mud of winter.
months.5: Clearer skies make the crater rim walks more reliable for expansive views. The steep climb up Mount Pico is open, though the summit can still catch passing clouds.
months.6: Long daylight hours and mostly clear skies provide excellent conditions for the high volcanic routes. The strenuous climb up Mount Pico rewards hikers with expansive mid-Atlantic views, while the coastal paths remain breezy.
months.7: The most reliable weather of the year keeps the high crater rims and the strenuous Mount Pico trail clear of cloud. The paths around Sete Cidades and Faial's Caldeira offer expansive views over the lakes and the ocean.
months.8: The most reliable weather of the year keeps the high crater rims and the strenuous Mount Pico trail clear of cloud. The paths around Sete Cidades and Faial's Caldeira offer expansive views over the lakes and the ocean.
months.10: Passing storms bring rain and cloud to the higher volcanic peaks. The coastal paths and lower forest trails remain in good condition, though the crater rims often lose their views by midday.
months.12: Frequent rain and low clouds often obscure the volcanic rims and make the steep trails muddy. The sheltered coastal paths and lower forest routes remain fully walkable.

argentine-lake-district.overview: The Argentine Lake District is known for its mountain trails through southern beech forests to granite spires and alpine lakes. The hiking centers on Nahuel Huapi National Park near Bariloche, where day hikes reach viewpoints over the lakes and a network of mountain huts supports multi-day treks. The long hike to Refugio Frey is the best-known route, climbing to a cirque of jagged peaks and a high lake. A free national park registration is required for the trails, and the refugios must be booked in advance.

months.9: The snow begins to melt in the lower valleys, opening some forest trails, but the high passes and the upper stretch of the Refugio Frey hike remain snowbound.

amsterdam.overview: The Netherlands is famously flat, so the walking within reach of the city is easy and mostly paved or graded. The best routes are under an hour away in Zuid-Kennemerland National Park, where paths wind through coastal dunes to the North Sea beach.

months.3: Temperatures are slightly warmer, making the walks through the coastal dunes more comfortable.
months.6: Summer provides warm, breezy days that are ideal for the paths to the North Sea beach.
months.7: Summer provides warm, breezy days that are ideal for the paths to the North Sea beach.
months.8: Summer provides warm, breezy days that are ideal for the paths to the North Sea beach.

atacama.overview: The high-altitude desert offers stark, otherworldly day hikes through slot canyons and jagged rock formations. The best-known routes explore the Valle de la Luna, where trails wind past sand dunes and salt-crusted cliffs, and the Guatin Canyon, known for its giant cacti. Most trailheads are reached by a short drive from San Pedro de Atacama, and tickets for popular areas must be bought in advance.

months.1: A brief weather pattern can bring rare afternoon storms and cloud cover to the high desert, but the canyon and valley trails usually remain open and walkable.
months.2: A brief weather pattern can bring rare afternoon storms and cloud cover to the high desert, but the canyon and valley trails usually remain open and walkable.

athens.overview: The mountains ringing the city offer day hikes a short drive from the center. Mount Parnitha, the highest, has trails through pine forests to mountain refuges, while Mount Hymettus has rocky, exposed routes with views over the capital and the Saronic Gulf. Spring and autumn are best, as summer brings dangerous heat and fire-risk trail closures.

months.1: Winter is mild and quiet on the trails, though Mount Parnitha can occasionally see light snow; the routes stay open.
months.2: Cool, damp conditions keep the lower slopes green, making for pleasant day hikes on the rocky paths of Mount Hymettus.
months.3: Spring arrives with blooming wildflowers across the hillsides, offering excellent hiking in cool, clear weather.
months.9: The worst of the heat begins to break, but trails remain dry and dusty; late in the month brings better conditions for walks.
months.11: Crisp, comfortable weather makes this a strong month for exploring the pine forests and loops of Mount Parnitha.
months.12: A quiet month for walking, with cool temperatures and occasional rain, but the rocky paths remain accessible for day hikes.

basque-country.overview: The Basque coast and green interior offer excellent day hikes, from the dramatic flysch cliffs between Zumaia and Deba to the steep climb up to the hermitage at San Juan de Gaztelugatxe. Inland, the trails of Gorbea Natural Park cross lush forests and open ridges. The best conditions run from late spring through early autumn, avoiding the heavy winter rains.

months.4: Conditions improve as the ground begins to dry, making the coastal cliff paths more reliable for day hikes.

aruba.overview: The arid scrub and rugged windward coast of Arikok National Park offer modest but scenic walking. Trails range from easy coastal paths to a climb up Mount Jamanota, the island's highest point, earning views of the Caribbean. The climate is hot year-round, so hikers start at dawn to beat the midday sun.

months.4: Temperatures rise, making the exposed trails hotter by mid-morning, so the climb up Mount Jamanota is best done at dawn.
months.5: Temperatures rise, making the exposed trails hotter by mid-morning, so the climb up Mount Jamanota is best done at dawn.

bordeaux.overview: Bordeaux is known for wine rather than wilderness, but easy walking trails thread through the surrounding vineyards and along the Atlantic coast an hour away. The best options are loops through the estates of Saint-Émilion or the sandy coastal paths near Arcachon Bay.

months.6: Clear skies and warm days offer excellent conditions for loops near Saint-Émilion.

big-island.overview: The Big Island offers a unique mix of volcanic landscapes and coastal trails, from the stark lava fields of Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park to the lush valleys of the north coast. The strenuous hike down into Waipi'o Valley or the trails around Kilauea's caldera show off scenery that can only be reached on foot. The dry season from May to September is the most reliable time to walk, especially on the rainier eastern side.

barbados.overview: Barbados offers modest walking along its rugged east coast and inland gullies. The best route is the coastal path from Bath to Bathsheba, passing Atlantic surf and limestone formations. Inland, short easy walks explore forest patches. Best from December to April.

months.4: Temperatures begin to creep up, but the trails remain dry and the coastal breezes keep the walks pleasant.

aspen.overview: The Elk Mountains offer high-altitude trails past alpine lakes and jagged peaks, with the best views reached by a mandatory shuttle to the Maroon Bells trailhead. Day hikes range from easy valley loops to strenuous climbs, while the Four Pass Loop is a strenuous 26-mile trek over four days. The best-known trails are crowded in summer, requiring timed reservations for the shuttle and parking. The main hiking season runs from July to September when the high passes are clear of snow.

months.1: Deep snow covers the mountains, so ordinary walking is closed, but groomed winter trails and snowshoe routes offer easy valley loops.
months.2: Deep snow covers the mountains, so ordinary walking is closed, but groomed winter trails and snowshoe routes offer easy valley loops.
months.3: Deep snow covers the mountains, so ordinary walking is closed, but groomed winter trails and snowshoe routes offer easy valley loops.
months.5: Lower trails clear of snow and offer day hikes, but the high passes and multi-day treks remain snowbound and closed to walkers.
months.7: The high passes are clear, opening the strenuous multi-day treks and high alpine day hikes, though the best-known trailheads are crowded and require timed reservations.
months.10: Snow returns to the high elevations, closing the multi-day treks, and the trailhead shuttles stop running, leaving only day hikes in the lower valleys.
months.12: Deep snow covers the mountains, so ordinary walking is closed, but groomed winter trails and snowshoe routes offer easy valley loops.

months.4: A transition month as the trekking window winds down. Snow dusts the higher passes, refugio and campsite availability shrinks, and valley day hikes remain open.
months.5: Deep snow and freezing temperatures close the high passes and the O Circuit. Most refugios shut down, leaving only a few day hikes accessible at lower elevations.
months.6: The trails are largely snowbound and the multi-day treks are closed to independent walkers. Only a few low-elevation paths remain open for short day hikes.
months.11: Long daylight hours return and the trails are in excellent condition. The strenuous multi-day circuits and day hikes are fully operational, though the famous winds are a constant factor.

months.5: Valley paths are clear, but the high alpine routes and passes remain closed by snow.

months.1: Mid-winter brings deep snow that blocks the high passes and expedition treks, but the skies are often crystal clear. Lower-elevation tea-house routes remain open, though nights are bitterly cold.
months.2: The high passes remain snowbound, while the lower valleys offer clear, quiet days on the trail. Temperatures rise slightly late in the month, making the foothills comfortable for walking.
months.3: Spring trekking conditions emerge as the snow line retreats and high passes become accessible. The lower trails are lined with the first blooming rhododendrons, with clear mornings, but afternoon haze and cloud often hide distant peaks at lower elevations.
months.4: The spring peak brings excellent conditions across the high routes, with massive rhododendron forests blooming in red, pink, and white along the lower trails. Mornings offer sharp mountain views before afternoon haze and cloud build, and views stay clearer above about 13,000 feet.
months.12: Winter cold sets in and snow begins to close the highest passes, ending the season for expedition treks. The skies remain brilliantly clear, offering excellent views on the lower-elevation routes.

months.5: Lower elevation trails and lakeshore paths are clear, but the high passes and alpine ridges are still holding deep snow and remain closed to ordinary hikers.

tokyo-kyoto.overview: The forested mountains surrounding both cities offer excellent day hikes reached easily by train, often with a cable car or chairlift to bypass the steepest climbs. Trails link ancient shrines and cedar groves, like the ridge path from Kurama to Kibune in Kyoto or the routes up Mount Takao and Mount Mitake outside Tokyo. Clear days on the Tokyo trails earn distant views of Mount Fuji.

months.2: Frost is common on the shaded ridges, but the shrine trails remain clear and easy to walk in the dry winter air.
months.4: Excellent walking weather brings bright green foliage to the cedar forests, and the ridge paths are completely clear.
months.10: The humidity breaks and crisp autumn air returns, making the shrine routes comfortable and dry.

dolomites.overview: Some of the world's most celebrated hiking, with limestone spires and alpine pastures reached by cable cars, gondolas and chairlifts that lift hikers onto ridge-top trails at Seceda, Lagazuoi and Alpe di Siusi, Europe's largest alpine meadow. The Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop is the classic day hike, and the 75-mile Alta Via 1 is a 10-day hut-to-hut trek from Lago di Braies to Belluno. Seceda, Lago di Braies and Tre Cime are crowded in summer, with timed lift slots, car restrictions or tolls. The season runs from late June to September.

months.1: Deep snow covers the high routes, but groomed winter walking paths and snowshoe trails in the valleys offer easy walking.
months.2: Deep snow covers the high routes, but groomed winter walking paths and snowshoe trails in the valleys offer easy walking.
months.3: Deep snow covers the high routes, but groomed winter walking paths and snowshoe trails in the valleys offer easy walking.
months.10: Many huts and lifts close by mid-month and early snow dusts the peaks, but lower trails remain open for quiet day hikes.

sedona.overview: Sedona is known for its red rock trails, where canyon hikes and steep sandstone scrambles lead to expansive desert views. Cathedral Rock is a short, hands-on scramble, Devil's Bridge ends at a natural sandstone arch, and Boynton Canyon is a longer hike that turns shadier toward its forested end. Summer heat requires starting at dawn.

months.1: Winter brings cool temperatures and occasional light snow or mud to the red rocks, making the canyon trails quiet and pleasant.

madeira.overview: Madeira is famous for its levadas, a network of irrigation channels more than 1,000 miles long, with hiking paths beside them through laurel forest and along cliffs, including a waterfall hike at Caldeirão Verde. The strenuous ridge hike from Pico do Arieiro to Pico Ruivo, 6,110 ft, earns views of the island's jagged volcanic spine when the cloud lifts. Winter brings rain and cloud to the heights; spring and early autumn are best.

months.1: Winter brings more rain and cloud to the high peaks, making the strenuous ridge routes slippery and less rewarding. The lower levada paths stay green, though walkers should expect occasional showers.
months.2: Winter brings more rain and cloud to the high peaks, making the strenuous ridge routes slippery and less rewarding. The lower levada paths stay green, though walkers should expect occasional showers.
months.12: Winter brings more rain and cloud to the high peaks, making the strenuous ridge routes slippery and less rewarding. The lower levada paths stay green, though walkers should expect occasional showers.

chicago.overview: The best hiking lies about an hour outside the city, where the trails of Indiana Dunes National Park cross wooded dunes to the lake. Closer in, the Palos Trail System offers loops through forest preserves. Spring and autumn bring the best weather, while winters are bitterly cold.

months.3: Trails begin to thaw, leaving the woodland loops muddy as the bitter cold eases.
months.5: The dune trails and forest paths are clear and green, offering the best hiking of the year before the heat sets in.
months.7: High heat and humidity make the woodland loops sticky and strenuous in the afternoon sun.
months.9: Humidity drops and temperatures cool, bringing excellent conditions to the dune routes.
